title: Withdrawal Request Exceeding Free Margin
precondition: Sub-account equity = $10,000; Used margin = $8,000; Free margin = $2,000.
expected: System blocks withdrawal: 'Requested amount ($4,000) exceeds available free margin ($2,000)'; suggests max allowable withdrawal.
coverage_note: Requires investor payment/withdrawal, lockup, reversal, or emergency LPOA workflow. Admin Set balance is not a substitute.
